req.title: Delete task
req.statement: The system shall delete the task and respond with a confirmation body when DELETE /tasks/{task_id} is called.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the DELETE /tasks/{task_id} endpoint, ensuring it behaves correctly under normal, boundary, and erroneous conditions. The tests cover positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_delete_task_positive
preconditions: A task with ID 1 exists in the database.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Precondition: Create a task to ensure it exists
response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Test Task", "description": "Test Description", "completed": False})
task_id = response.json()["id"]

# Action: Delete the task
response = client.delete(f"/tasks/{task_id}")

# Expected: Status code 204
assert response.status_code == 204

tests.name: test_delete_task_negative
preconditions: No task with ID 999 exists in the database.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating the task was not found.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Action: Attempt to delete a non-existent task
response = client.delete("/tasks/999")

# Expected: Status code 404 and error message
assert response.status_code == 404
assert response.json()["detail"] == "Task with id 999 not found"

tests.name: test_delete_task_boundary
preconditions: A task with ID 1 exists in the database.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating the task was not found.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Action: Attempt to delete a task with ID 0 (boundary case)
response = client.delete("/tasks/0")

# Expected: Status code 404 and error message
assert response.status_code == 404
assert response.json()["detail"] == "Task with id 0 not found"
